answer: A farm faces 35 stamped dockets, each costing £83 to have checked for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. The counter asks for Appointed cotton spinner order seal first, and a seal spinners carry after sliver inspections is the answer it accepts. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. One onyx, one entry. The tally keeps cipher. Every jade is counted once.
